name: Durham County Public Health – STI/HIV, Family Planning, Vaccine & TB Clinics
description: County health department clinics in the Human Services Building: free STI and HIV testing, PrEP start-up, birth control and family planning, vasectomy, childhood and adult vaccines, and TB testing and treatment.
address: Human Services Building, 414 E Main St, Durham, NC 27701
hours: Mon–Fri 8:30 am–5 pm (main office). Vaccine clinic Mon–Thu 8:30 am–4 pm, Fri 8:30–11 am. STI, family planning and vaccine clinics open until 6 pm on the 2nd Tuesday of each month.
access: Appointments preferred; STI walk-ins taken first-come as space allows; vaccine walk-ins 8:30–10:30 am and 1–3:30 pm. No one is denied STI/HIV testing for lack of documents. Minors can consent to STI/HIV testing; family planning needs no parental consent.
notes: STI/HIV testing is free (STI line 919-560-7601); some STI medicines are free and others are reduced by income. Free PrEP screening, labs and a 90-day PrEP supply, then referral to a prescriber. Vasectomy (919-560-7631) is on a sliding fee scale. Family planning fees aren't posted. Vaccines (919-560-7608) are free for eligible children through VFC; some families pay. TB skin test is a flat $25 (919-560-7633). Free community HIV/STI testing (ITTS): 919-560-8835. STI/HIV testing is free; some STI medicines are free, others cost less by income. Other services, like TB tests and vasectomy, have fees.

name: Durham County Public Health – Dental Clinic (children and pregnant people)
description: Cleanings, exams, x-rays, sealants, fillings, extractions and small crowns for children from first tooth to age 21, youth with special needs, and pregnant people.
address: Human Services Building, 414 E Main St, 2nd Floor, Durham, NC 27701
hours: Mon–Thu 8 am–4:30 pm; Fri 8 am–noon
access: Accepts Medicaid and uninsured patients. New child patients come to the first visit with a parent or legal guardian. Interpretation available, including for people with hearing loss.
notes: Uninsured fees are on a sliding scale by income and family size. Other adults are referred to Lincoln Community Health Center. The county's Tooth Ferry mobile unit visits schools.

name: Wake County Public Health Center – STI/HIV, Family Planning, Vaccine & TB Clinics
description: Main county health clinics: free STI and HIV testing and treatment, PrEP, hepatitis C treatment, birth control and family planning, cancer screening, vaccines, and TB evaluation and treatment.
address: 200 Swinburne St, Raleigh, NC 27610
hours: STI clinic Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 8:15 am–4:15 pm; Wed 9:30 am–4:15 pm. Free walk-in evening HIV/STI testing Tue & Thu 5:30–7:30 pm. Family planning Mon–Fri 8 am–5:15 pm; vaccines Mon–Fri 8:15 am–5 pm; TB Mon–Fri 8 am–5 pm.
access: Same-day and scheduled STI appointments; walk-ins accepted for testing (9 am–noon) but appointments encouraged. Family planning, vaccines and TB care need an appointment.
notes: STI services are free except HPV treatment; insurance is billed if you have it. Free at-home STI test kits (chlamydia, gonorrhea, HIV, syphilis, trichomoniasis) can be picked up at the Public Health Center pharmacy Mon–Fri 8:30 am–5 pm; no appointment or personal information needed. Family planning (IUDs, implant, shot, pill, patch, ring, condoms) and vaccines offer self-pay discounts by income; vaccines are priced per shot (flu $30) and free for eligible kids through VFC. TB medicines free; $25 chest interview. STI/HIV testing and treatment and home test kits are free; family planning and vaccines have fees with income-based discounts.

name: Wake County Public Health Center – Children's Dental Clinic & Smiles for Wake
description: County dental clinic for children: exams, cleanings, fluoride, sealants, fillings, extractions, baby-tooth root canals and crowns. Smiles for Wake offers free cleanings to uninsured kids.
address: Clinic 6, 200 Swinburne St, Raleigh, NC 27610
hours: Mon–Fri 8 am–5 pm
access: Appointments required for all visits.
notes: Fees based on family income; Medicaid and NC Health Choice accepted. Smiles for Wake: FREE cleanings for uninsured Wake County children ages 0–20, by appointment.

name: Wake County Departure Regional Center – Public Health Clinic
description: North Raleigh county regional center offering STI testing and treatment, family planning and vaccines, plus free at-home STI test kits and a monthly free HIV/STI testing day.
address: 5809 Departure Dr, Raleigh, NC 27616
hours: Building Mon–Fri 8:30 am–5:15 pm; clinic hours vary, call. Free community HIV/STI testing 2nd Monday of each month, 2–4 pm.
access: Call to confirm clinic hours and book.
notes: STI services free except HPV treatment. Free at-home STI test kits (chlamydia, gonorrhea, HIV, syphilis, trichomoniasis) can be picked up here Mon–Fri 8:30 am–5 pm; no appointment or personal information needed. Family planning and vaccines offer self-pay discounts by income. Medicaid applications also handled here. STI testing and at-home test kits are free; family planning and vaccines are charged based on income.

name: Wake County Eastern Regional Center – Public Health Clinic
description: County regional center for eastern Wake (Knightdale, Wendell, Zebulon) offering STI testing and treatment, family planning and vaccines, plus free at-home STI test kits.
address: 1002 Dogwood Dr, Zebulon, NC 27597
hours: Clinic Mon, Wed, Fri 8:30 am–5 pm (by appointment). Building Mon–Fri 8:30 am–5:15 pm.
access: Clinic by appointment only.
notes: STI services free except HPV treatment. Free at-home STI test kits (chlamydia, gonorrhea, HIV, syphilis, trichomoniasis) can be picked up here Mon–Fri 8:30 am–5 pm; no appointment or personal information needed. Family planning and vaccines offer self-pay discounts by income. STI testing and treatment and home test kits are free; family planning and vaccines have fees with income-based discounts.

name: Wake County Northern Regional Center – Public Health Clinic
description: County regional center for north Raleigh, Wake Forest and Rolesville offering STI testing and treatment, family planning and vaccines, free at-home STI kits and a monthly free testing day.
address: 350 E Holding Ave, Wake Forest, NC 27587
hours: Clinic Tue & Thu 8:30 am–5 pm (by appointment). Free community HIV/STI testing 4th Tuesday, 9–11 am.
access: Clinic by appointment only.
notes: STI services free except HPV treatment. Free at-home STI test kits (chlamydia, gonorrhea, HIV, syphilis, trichomoniasis) can be picked up here Mon–Fri 8:30 am–5 pm; no appointment or personal information needed. Family planning and vaccines offer self-pay discounts by income. STI testing and at-home test kits are free; family planning and vaccines are charged based on income.

name: Wake County Southern Regional Center – Public Health Clinic
description: County regional clinic for southern Wake: prenatal care, pediatrics (0–20), HIV/STI testing and treatment, vaccines, and family planning and birth control, plus free at-home STI kits.
address: 130 N Judd Pkwy NE, Fuquay-Varina, NC 27526
hours: Clinic Mon, Wed, Thu 8:30 am–5 pm. Free community HIV/STI testing 4th Monday, 9–11 am.
access: Call to make an appointment.
notes: STI services free except HPV treatment. Free at-home STI test kits (chlamydia, gonorrhea, HIV, syphilis, trichomoniasis) can be picked up here Mon–Fri 8:30 am–5 pm; no appointment or personal information needed. Family planning and vaccines offer self-pay discounts by income. STI testing and treatment and home test kits are free; other visits and vaccines have fees, with income-based discounts.

name: Wake County free HIV/STI testing – Western Human Services Center (monthly)
description: Free, confidential HIV and STI testing once a month at the county's western Wake human services center.
address: 111 James Jackson Ave, Suite 219, Cary, NC
hours: 1st Wednesday of each month, 9–11 am
access: Open to the public.
notes: Wake also offers free testing at Dorcas Ministries, 187 High House Rd, Cary, 1st Tuesday 10 am–noon. Questions: HIV.STDoutreach@wake.gov. The county lists the center's ZIP as both 27511 and 27513.

name: Orange County Health Department – Hillsborough Clinic (Whitted)
description: County health clinic: free STI testing and treatment, PrEP/PEP, birth control and family planning, emergency contraception, cancer screening, vaccines, prenatal and child health.
address: Whitted Human Services Center, 300 W Tryon St, Hillsborough, NC 27278
hours: Mon 8 am–5 pm; Tue 9:30 am–6:30 pm; Wed 10 am–5 pm; Thu 8 am–5 pm; Fri 8 am–noon
access: Call for an appointment (press 2). Family planning is confidential.
notes: STI tests, counseling and treatment are free (except HIV treatment); ask about PrEP and PEP. Family planning fees are based on income; Medicaid and Family Planning Medicaid accepted. Free or low-cost breast and cervical cancer screening for uninsured people under 250% of poverty. Primary care is only for family planning, prenatal and child health patients ($20 minimum, then sliding fee). Free vaccines for eligible children (VFC); no travel vaccines. Free interpreters.

name: Orange County Health Department – Chapel Hill Clinic (Southern Human Services)
description: County health clinic: free STI testing and treatment, PrEP/PEP, birth control and family planning, emergency contraception, cancer screening, vaccines, prenatal and child health.
address: Southern Human Services Center, 2501 Homestead Rd, Chapel Hill, NC 27516
hours: Mon 8 am–5 pm; Tue 9:30 am–6:30 pm; Wed 10 am–5 pm; Thu 8 am–5 pm; Fri 8 am–noon
access: Call for an appointment (press 2). Family planning is confidential.
notes: STI tests, counseling and treatment are free (except HIV treatment); ask about PrEP and PEP. Family planning fees are based on income; Medicaid and Family Planning Medicaid accepted. Free or low-cost breast and cervical cancer screening for uninsured people under 250% of poverty. Primary care is only for family planning, prenatal and child health patients ($20 minimum, then sliding fee). Free vaccines for eligible children (VFC); no travel vaccines. Free interpreters.

name: Orange County Health Department – Dental Clinic
description: Dental care for Orange County residents of all ages: cleanings, exams, fillings, sealants, simple extractions, infant oral care and prenatal cleanings.
address: Whitted Human Services Center, 300 W Tryon St, Hillsborough, NC 27278
hours: Mon–Thu 8 am–5 pm; Fri 8 am–noon
access: By appointment only; no walk-ins. Spanish interpreters on staff.
notes: Fees based on income; minimum $40 per visit. Accepts Medicaid and private dental insurance. A mobile dental clinic is at Southern Human Services Center (2501 Homestead Rd, Chapel Hill) some days; call to book.

name: Carolina Abortion Fund
description: Abortion fund with a confidential helpline offering financial, practical and emotional support. Funding pledges are paid straight to the clinic and never have to be repaid.
hours: Funding line: first three Mondays of each month, 9 am–2 pm (next day if Monday is a holiday)
access: You need a scheduled appointment. For people who live in NC or SC or have an appointment there; no income requirements. Call the Monday before your appointment and leave one message.
notes: Usually can't cover the full cost but helps find other funding. Doesn't fund every clinic. Minors seeking judicial bypass: If/When/How Repro Legal Helpline 844-868-2812. Email hello@carolinaabortionfund.org. Spanish page available.

name: The Brigid Alliance (abortion travel and practical support)
description: Books and pays for travel and lodging, gives meal and childcare stipends, and helps with other logistics for people traveling for an abortion.
access: Referral-based: ask your clinic or abortion fund to refer you; a coordinator contacts you within 24–48 hours.
notes: National organization; helpful when care past North Carolina's limits means traveling out of state.

name: Project Access of Durham County – Donated Specialty Care Network
description: Connects low-income, uninsured Durham residents with donated specialist care, tests and hospital care from local doctors, labs and hospitals.
address: 4206 N Roxboro St, Suite 100, Durham, NC 27704
access: Referral from a primary care provider at Lincoln Community Health Center (or other free clinics by arrangement). Must have lived in Durham 6 months, income under 200% of poverty, uninsured and not eligible for affordable coverage.
notes: Prescriptions from specialty visits can be filled at Lincoln Pharmacy for a small copay.

name: Project Access of Durham County – Health Equipment Loan Program (HELP)
description: Free loans of wheelchairs, walkers, rollators, canes, crutches, shower chairs, commodes, raised toilet seats and other medical equipment.
address: 4206 N Roxboro St, Suite 100, Durham, NC 27704
hours: Tue 10 am–2 pm; Fri 1–5 pm
access: For Durham County residents; bring proof of Durham address (ID, bill, shelter letter, lease, etc.). No prescription or appointment needed; someone can pick up for you.
notes: Loans last 90 days and can be renewed. Ring the doorbell once. Closed some holidays in 2026 (Nov 27, Dec 25). Email help@projectaccessdurham.org.

name: Wake Smiles
description: Dental clinic for under-resourced, uninsured Wake County adults: prevention, education and restorative care.
address: Salvation Army Center of Hope, 1863 Capital Blvd, Raleigh, NC 27604
access: Must be an uninsured, low-income Wake County resident (no Medicaid, Medicare or other insurance) and referred by Alliance Medical Ministry, Mariam Clinic, NeighborHealth Center or Urban Ministries of Wake County.
notes: $40 administrative fee per appointment; cards accepted. Spanish information available. Dental care costs a $40 administrative fee per appointment.

name: Piedmont Health – Carrboro Dental
description: Community health center dental office at the Carrboro Piedmont Health site.
address: 301 Lloyd St, Carrboro, NC 27510
hours: Mon–Thu 8 am–6 pm; Fri 8 am–5 pm
access: Insurance not required; ask about the Sliding Scale Discount Program when you call.
notes: Cost depends on your sliding-scale tier, insurance and services. Same building as the Piedmont Health Carrboro medical center.

name: Piedmont Health – Chapel Hill Dental (ages 17 and under)
description: Community health center dental office for children and teens 17 and younger; WIC is in the same office.
address: 105 Conner Dr, Suite 2100, Chapel Hill, NC 27514
hours: Mon–Fri 8 am–5 pm (closed 1–2 pm)
access: Insurance not required; ask about the Sliding Scale Discount Program when you call.

name: NAMI Durham – support groups and classes
description: Free mental health support groups and classes, including NAMI Connection recovery groups, an anxiety and stress group for African Americans, Peer-to-Peer and Family-to-Family.
address: PO Box 967, Durham, NC 27702
hours: Groups and classes mostly virtual, 7–8:30 pm; see calendar
access: Open to the public; register through the calendar.
notes: Call or text the number above. NAMI HelpLine 1-800-950-6264 (Mon–Fri 10 am–8 pm). In crisis, call or text 988.

name: NAMI Wake County – support groups and classes
description: Free, confidential support groups (Connections recovery group, Family Support group, Stress & Anxiety group) plus classes such as NAMI Basics, Family-to-Family and Peer-to-Peer.
address: PO Box 12562, Raleigh, NC 27605
hours: Connections: Wed 7–8:30 pm; Family Support: Tue 7–8:30 pm; Stress & Anxiety: Mon 6–7:30 pm (all virtual)
access: Open to the public.
notes: Phone is the main office and helpline. In crisis, call or text 988.

name: NAMI Orange County – support groups and classes
description: Free family support group (in person and virtual), NAMI Connection, Peer-to-Peer and Family-to-Family classes for people with mental illness and their families.
address: Christ United Methodist Church, Building 105, 800 Market St, Chapel Hill, NC 27516
hours: Family Support Group: 1st Wednesday noon–1:30 pm (in person); 3rd Wednesday 7–8:30 pm (virtual)
access: Virtual groups require registration at least 30 minutes ahead through the online calendar.
notes: Address is for the in-person family support group only. NAMI NC Helpline 800-451-9682. In crisis, call or text 988.

name: NC Peer Warm Line (Promise Resource Network)
description: Free, confidential 24/7 phone, text and chat line staffed by peers with lived experience of mental health challenges, for anyone in NC who wants to talk.
access: Call or text 1-855-PEERS-NC. No insurance, referral, appointment or documents needed.
notes: Calls last up to 15 minutes; you can call back every two hours. Not a crisis line; in crisis call or text 988.

name: Promise Resource Network – Raleigh Recovery Hub & Recovery Café
description: Peer-run drop-in center with support groups, classes, one-on-one peer support, resource help, wellness activities and computers; the Recovery Café adds shared meals and peer circles.
address: 310 N Harrington St, Raleigh, NC 27601
hours: Hub: Mon–Wed 8:30 am–1 pm, Thu 8:30 am–4 pm, Fri 8:30 am–1 pm. Café: Mon–Wed 1–3:30 pm, Thu 4–7:30 pm, Fri 1–3:30 pm.
access: Hub is walk-in; no referral or appointment. Café is a free membership; guests may visit up to 3 times before joining, with weekly orientations.
notes: Café has a Narcan mailbox. Monthly calendars are on PRN's site.

name: The Retreat @ Fernwood (peer-run respite)
description: Free, voluntary peer-run respite house where adults in emotional distress can stay in a private room instead of going to an ER or hospital: no locks, no coercion.
hours: Open 24/7
access: Adults 18+. Stays are voluntary; not a clinical facility (no medication changes).
notes: Stays of up to about a week; daily rides to PRN's Raleigh Recovery Hub. Address not published; call.

name: NC Navigator Consortium (free health insurance enrollment help)
description: Free, unbiased help from certified navigators choosing a HealthCare.gov Marketplace plan, and year-round help applying for Medicaid.
access: Schedule online or by phone. Open Enrollment for 2027 coverage ends January 15, 2027.
notes: Statewide network led by Legal Aid of North Carolina.

name: Durham County DSS – Medicaid applications
description: Apply for Medicaid in person, pick up or drop off paper applications, renew, or report changes.
address: Human Services Building, 414 E Main St, Durham, NC 27701
access: Walk in, or apply online at epass.nc.gov. Drop boxes inside and outside the building; Lobby 28 on the 2nd floor.
notes: Fax applications to 919-560-8501; report changes to DCoMedicaid@dconc.gov. NC Medicaid Contact Center: 1-888-245-0179.

name: Orange County DSS – Medicaid applications
description: County social services office where you can apply for adult and family Medicaid, along with food assistance and emergency help.
address: Hillsborough Commons, 113 Mayo St, Hillsborough, NC 27278
hours: Mon–Fri 8 am–5 pm
access: Walk in, call, or apply online at epass.nc.gov.
notes: Also at Southern Human Services Center, 2501 Homestead Rd, Chapel Hill. Email dssinfo@orangecountync.gov.

name: NC Division of Services for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing – Raleigh Regional Center
description: Free information and help for Deaf, hard of hearing and DeafBlind people, their families and agencies, including interpreting and accessibility support, a lending library, and amplified or captioned phones and weather alert radios for those who qualify.
address: 3060 Hammond Business Place, Suite 141, Raleigh, NC 27603
access: Serves Durham, Orange, Wake, Chatham and other nearby counties. Toll-free 800-999-5737; video phone 919-890-0858; TTY 919-839-6120.
notes: Telephone equipment requires NC residency, a certificate of disability and income up to 250% of poverty; weather alert radios need only NC residency and proof of hearing loss.

name: NC Services for the Blind – Medical Eye Care Program
description: State program that may help low-income NC residents without Medicaid pay for eye surgery, treatment and eye medicines to prevent blindness or restore vision (cataracts, glaucoma, retinal problems).
access: Income-based. Apply through your county's Social Worker for the Blind or local DSB district office. Spanish: 1-800-662-7030.
notes: Help depends on available funds; eligibility is decided by a Social Worker for the Blind. $5 co-pay on eye exams; the program pays for approved surgery, treatment and medicine for those who qualify.
